review_evidence: The 404 TvmLean/ files are the actual TVM model, instruction representation, semantics, spec/index/validation support and are retained.

A complete tree scan found 930 Tests/*.lean files and zero theorem/lemma/axiom/example declarations; 919 files define `InstrSuite` executable unit/oracle/fuzz registries around retained semantics. Representative ADD and CTOS suites were inspected and are dominated by case generation, expected stacks/errors/gas budgets and runner registration.

All 9 Apps/*.lean files likewise contain zero theorem/lemma/axiom/example declarations and implement CLI/debug/coverage/differential-test/oracle/progress programs. lakefile.lean is build/target configuration.
